title: Knowledge Model (Understanding Model)
description: The central conceptual entity of the knowledge bank (SYSTEM_SPEC section 9). An Understanding Model describes what a student must understand in order to successfully complete a recurring kind of assessment task. It describes competence being assessed, not an answer to a question. This is the 'knowledge-model schema' referenced by Phase 1 and is stored under database/schema/knowledge_model.schema.json; the understanding_model alias resolves to the same file.

definition.description: A precise description of the competence assessed.

question_family.description: Link to the question family this model belongs to.

assessment_operations.description: The assessment operations the model captures.

required_knowledge.description: Facts, concepts, definitions, rules, relationships the student must know.

prerequisites.description: What must be understood beforehand; may reference other models or knowledge items.

required_procedure.description: The procedure a student must be able to execute.

evidence_of_understanding.description: What a student must demonstrate to show understanding.

marking_requirements.description: Marking requirements drawn from memo/rubric evidence.

common_breakdowns.description: Breakdown ids that may apply to this model.

misconceptions.description: Documented misconceptions if source-supported; otherwise mark as derived (Tier 3).

diagnostic_dimensions.description: Stages/dimensions along which understanding can be probed (SYSTEM_SPEC section 10).

provenance.description: Traceable provenance chain, e.g. knowledge item -> model -> family -> question -> memo -> source -> ORC source.

version.description: Semantic version of this model, set at freeze time.
